# The Three Releases

*Generated by `node scripts/split-sets.mjs` — edit the tables at the top of that script, not this file.*

The 656 cards split into three releases, with ten packs between them. Every card is printed in exactly one release. The one exception is Statues: each market deck needs nine to play on its own, so later market decks reprint earlier ones.

- **Packs.** Every pack holds 50–60 different cards: Characters, plus the Events and Town Buildings that go with them. Each card is in exactly one pack. Set 1 got a third pack (the Town Square pack) because its Events and Town Buildings didn’t fit in two.
- **Starter decks.** Each deck is a fixed 40-card list built from its own release’s pack cards. Every deck card can also be pulled from that release’s packs, so art and foil variants of deck cards can go in packs.
- **Masters.** Some animals arrive in their species’ release with their early versions, and their top Master arrives a release or two later. Any version can be recruited on its own at full printed cost. The upgrade discount (pay only the difference) applies once you own a cheaper version of the same animal.
- **Events.** An Event that needs a named animal goes with that animal’s early versions.

## Animals that move

These animals move with every version to a pack other than their species’ home pack. Some move to the mixed pack of their own release so no pack goes over sixty cards. The rest wait for a later release, chosen in this order: animals in no printed deck, then late additions to the cast, then animals working outside their species’ two deck studies.

## Masters that arrive later

- **Statues:** Statue of Harmony, Statue of Hospitality, Statue of Thrift, Statue of Kindness *(reprint from Set 1)*, Statue of Curiosity *(reprint from Set 1)*, Statue of Courage *(reprint from Set 1)*, Statue of Patience *(reprint from Set 1)*, Statue of Generosity *(reprint from Set 1)*, Statue of Ingenuity *(reprint from Set 1)*, Statue of Community *(reprint from Set 1)*, Statue of Diligence *(reprint from Set 1)*, Statue of Joy *(reprint from Set 1)*

### The Grand Exchange (market deck) — 24 lots and a quarry of 11 Statues

Set 3’s one Capital City: every Set 3 market card, and the loudest weather in the collection. Market card 9 · Disruption 5 · Capital City Building 4 · Market Character 4 · Ordinance 2.

- **Statues:** Statue of Wonder, Statue of Mercy, Statue of Harmony *(reprint from Set 2)*, Statue of Hospitality *(reprint from Set 2)*, Statue of Thrift *(reprint from Set 2)*, Statue of Curiosity *(reprint from Set 1)*, Statue of Courage *(reprint from Set 1)*, Statue of Generosity *(reprint from Set 1)*, Statue of Ingenuity *(reprint from Set 1)*, Statue of Diligence *(reprint from Set 1)*, Statue of Joy *(reprint from Set 1)*
- **Market Characters:** Bob, Gate Attendant, Mittens, Rooftop Cat, Faustus, Threadmaster, Eustace, Socialite
- **Capital City Buildings:** The Airport, The Hospital, The Fast Food Joint, The Festival Green
- **Market cards:** Roger's Ha'penny, The Mended Mangle, The Lucky Horseshoe, The Courier Network, The Town Archives, The Double Shift Horn, The Town Clock, Founder's Grant, The Spare Room
- **Disruptions:** The Year It Stopped, The Cutting Comes Down, The Midsummer Fair, The Lord Mayor's Fair, The Casino Fundraiser
- **Ordinances:** The Quarry Road Is Out, A Word With the Steward

## Checks this list passes

- All 656 cards are placed exactly once.
- Every pack holds 50–60 different cards.
- Every Master that arrives later has a cheaper version of the same animal in an earlier release.
- No Event is printed before the animal or species it requires.
- Every market deck can raise nine Statues on its own.
- Every starter deck is legal under the deck rules and uses only cards from its own release.
